lines.en: Recruit, this is Nightfin. You're cleared for your first deployment. Hit Play when you're ready.
It's the big button, Recruit. The one that says Play.
Drag anywhere to move. Your gun fires on its own. Just stay alive.
Keep moving, Recruit. Standing still is how they get you.
That's it. You're a natural.
First kill! See the bar up top? That's your XP!
Fill the bar, you level up! Easy, right?
Level up. Pick one card. No timer this time. Think.
One card each level. Six skills. Four stats. Then rank them up.
That's a signal relay. ...Stand in the ring for twelve seconds. I'll handle the rest.
You stepped out. ...It's okay, it drains slowly. Hop back in.
Uplink's up. ...HQ sent you a card. Pick one.
Ooh, a supply cache. Stand on the pad, pay a few coins, and pick a card.
Not quite enough coins yet, sweetie. Come back after a few more kills.
The price goes up every time you buy. Spend it wisely, okay?
Boss beacon! Step in and an Alpha comes for you! Only if you're ready!
Here it comes! Keep moving, keep moving!
Alpha down. That's a first for you. Go grab the chest it dropped.
Drop incoming. Stand next to the pod for a second to open it.
Coins and a little something extra. I packed it myself.
Med station. ...Stand in it to switch it on, then stay inside.
It's healing you now. ...Eight seconds. Don't wander off.
Oh, you're hurt. Look for a med station, sweetie. Green light, you can't miss it.
Ooh, a magnet. Every coin on the map is flying to you.
Bomb! Boom! Everything on screen, gone! Elites... less gone.
Freeze clock. ...Four seconds. Make them count.
First chest. Rank a power to five. Own its partner card. The next chest evolves it.
Claim it. No rush this time.
You're down, Recruit. The first one's on HQ. Get back up.
There you are. Let's not make that a habit.
The horde got you. It gets everyone, eventually. That was good work for day one.
I topped you up to four hundred coins. Go say hi to Lukas, he's been waiting.
Finally! Makarov. Hits harder, shoots faster than that sad little pistol. You have the coins. Buy her!
Ja! Now you have a real gun. Be nice to her!
Wait, wait! You're leaving? With all those coins? Nein!
Daily gifts are open now. Come by every day, I'll always have something for you.
Level two. Missions are open. Clear them. Earn Pass rewards. Every day.
Three missions. No excuses.
Level three. The supply crates are open, and your first pull is on me.
Ooh, let me see. Oh, and doubles turn into shards, so nothing goes to waste.
Level five! Gun stars! Shards and coins go in, damage comes out! Wunderbar!
One more star! Look at her shine! I'm not crying. Gun oil.
That's basic training done, Recruit. From here on, it's you and the horde. Nightfin out.
Ready when you are, Recruit.
The board's quiet right now. I don't trust it.
Deploying you now. Keep your eyes open.
The drop zone's hot today. Move fast and you'll be fine.
New sector on the map! Race you there!
New record. I'm putting that one on the board.
Pulling you out. We'll talk about it later.
Welcome to the Nest! Touch nothing! Okay, touch a little.
Don't name your guns. You'll get attached. ...They're all Greta.
Ka-chunk! Oh, that one kicks! You'll love her!
Wunderbar! That... that is a real weapon. Give me a moment.
Not enough coins! I don't do discounts! ...Except for Mai. Once.
Three missions. No excuses.
Done. Good habit.
Pass level up. You earned it.
Stronger than yesterday. That is the job.
Rest is training too. Come back tomorrow.
Fresh stock today. I saw you looking at that one.
Feeling lucky today, sweetie?
Oh my. A Legendary. Look at you!
It's getting close. I can feel it. ...Probably.
Your daily crate is ready. I wrapped it nicely.
Seven days in a row. You're family now, you know that?
Settings. ...Change whatever feels right.
Fit check. ...Honestly, not bad.
Oh. ...You picked mine. Good taste.
Checking my record? It's still standing! Try harder!
Welcome back, Recruit. The horde wasn't polite while you were gone.
Threat's rising. They know you're here now.
Another tier up. Keep moving and you'll be fine.
Threat ten. This is where most agents call for pickup. You don't have to.
Here they come! So many of them!
Surge! Don't get boxed in!
Alpha on the field! Keep your distance!
Alpha neutralized. Nicely done. Grab the chest.
Big one down! Check the drop!
Ha! Did you see her work? Beautiful!
A hundred down! Keep going!
Five hundred?! Okay, okay, I'm still ahead. Probably!
A thousand! Okay. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone!
Level up. Choose well.
Evolution. This is what training looks like.
Station's done. ...Nice.
Clean work. ...I'm taking notes.
You're hurt, sweetie. Find a med station, okay?
Hey. Please be careful. I mean it.
Coins on the way to you.
Boom! Wunderbar!
Frozen. ...Go.
You just beat your best time. Every second from here is a new record.
You're down, Recruit.
You're down. Your call, Recruit.
Deployment's over. That's good data, Recruit.
Get some rest. We go again soon.
You stopped moving, Recruit. They didn't.
You're sitting on a lot of coins, sweetie. Lukas keeps staring at them.
You walked right past my drop. I packed that one myself, you know.
Scared of the beacon? It's fine! I was too! For one day!
Under a minute. Again. Slower this time.
Twice in a row. Take a breath, Recruit. Then we'll try again.
Two minutes. No hits. That is not luck. That is footwork.
Careful on the bridge. Choke points work for them, not for you.
Please don't touch the goo. ...I have a list of reasons.
Fifteen minutes. I'm warming up your snacks now.
You let the timer choose. The timer does not care about you. I do.
All stats. No skills. Muscle without technique.
Still the pistol?! She's tired! Let her rest! Take Greta!
You've been looking at the menu for a while. ...Me too, honestly.
Full health... using a med station. ...Bold. I respect it.
Most agents quit after the first fall. You didn't. I noticed.
HQ pays per kill. Please don't ask me who set the rates.
Every sector we clear, somebody gets to go home. Keep that in mind.
Status check. You're alive. That's a great report.
Nobody knows where the outbreak started. We just know where it's heading.
Mai wants me to tell you she's proud of you. I'm only relaying.
Don't fight the whole horde. Just win the next ten seconds.
Hear that sound? A well-kept weapon! Music!
If it's green and it moves, shoot it! If it's green and it doesn't move... shoot it anyway!
In Hamburg I fixed fishing boats. Now I fix guns. Same smell! Better company!
I talk to my guns at night. They listen better than Kaito!
Your aim is fine! The gun does all the work, but fine!
Breathe. Move. Shoot. Repeat.
Your footwork is better. I noticed.
I used to box. Mutants don't follow rules either. Fair.
Strong is not hitting hard. Strong is getting up.
Mai says I should smile more on the radio. This is me smiling.
It's quiet. Too quiet! I hate it! Make some noise!
They look cute until they bite! ...Okay, still kind of cute.
Bet I'd be at five hundred by now! Just saying!
Scouted the next sector! It's worse! You'll love it!
Ji-ho bet me lunch you'd last ten minutes! Don't make me pay!
Relay signal's clean. ...For now.
It smells worse than yesterday. ...Somehow.
Note to self... never touch the goo. Again.
Machines break. People too. ...Both can be fixed.
Kaito asked if the mask is for the smell. ...It is now.
I packed snacks for when you're back. So come back, okay?
Grab the coins, sweetie. I'm counting. Out loud.
This sector is so pretty. Shame about the mutants.
Supply runs are boring. That's the point. Boring means everyone eats.
You took a hit. I saw. ...Everyone saw, sweetie.
Ji-ho! How many today?
...Didn't count.
So, less than me!
...Three hundred twelve.
Chen! Your recruit is holding my pistol wrong!
My recruit is alive. Your pistol is fine.
Boss, can I put snacks in the drops?
Drops are for ammo, Mai.
Ammo doesn't taste very good, though.
Ji-ho, do you ever take that mask off?
Not even to eat?
...Next question.
Lukas! I want the biggest gun you've got!
Nein! You'll fall over!
Worth it!
Threat climbs faster in Whiteout. We need a plan.
Then we train harder.
Or we send the recruit.
...Same thing.
The new one's doing really well, don't you think?
Better than my first day!
You cried on your first day, sweetie.
Wind in my eyes!
I could add a scope to that. ...If you want.
She has a scope!
...A better one.
...Show me. Right now.
Did you see that?! The recruit took down an Alpha!
I saw it. Put it in the log.
Now do it again.
Seven days in a row. That's lovely.
Discipline.
I was going to say snacks.
Who named it Signal Relay? So boring!
...I did.
Great name! Classic! Love it!
Boss, do you ever sleep?
When the board is clear.
The board is never clear.
Then you have your answer, Mai.
Lukas, what did you name the shotgun?
Greta!
And the sniper?
Also Greta! She knows!
Some of them are honestly kind of cute.
Focus.
The round one, with the tiny feet.
...Shoot the round one.
Chen! Say something nice for once!
...Acceptable.
That's the nicest thing he's ever said!
Coffee, anyone? Vietnamese style. Very strong.
How strong?
Ji-ho had one and fixed three relays in an hour.
...I don't remember that hour.
Riley, where did you find this recruit?
They found us, actually.
That's not an answer!
It's the only one that matters, Kaito.
Chen, someone's been feeding the hangar cat.
Not me.
It sleeps on your jacket.
...It is a good cat.
Lukas, are you scared of Chen?
Nein! I respect him! From far away!
I can hear you.
...From very far away.
Greenbelt. The first infected sector. They're dense but slow, so it's a good place to learn.
Deepwood! Trees everywhere, and elites hiding in them! I counted! Too many!
Blackmire. ...Narrow paths between toxic pools. Always know where the bridge is.
Cinder Ridge! Hot ground! Hot guns! And something big is digging under the lava!
Whiteout. The worst infection we know of. Visibility's low, so stay close to the radio.
That's Thornback! Plant-type Alpha! Don't hug it! Seriously!
Burrow King! It comes up right under you! Don't stand still!
Bone Colossus. It's the biggest thing we've ever logged. Don't let it corner you.
When the horde comes, people make a call. We're the ones who pick up.
Where do the powers come from. Does not matter. Use them well.
The mask filters the air. ...And people. Mostly people.
Every coin you bring back keeps a supply line open somewhere.
I used to do night rescues. On radar, I was just a little fin in the dark.
Why Raptor? Raptors are small, loud, and correct! Like me!
Kaito named me Dragon. I did not agree. It stayed.
Why Shark? Because sharks are cool! ...Not because of Riley! Shut up!
They call me Smog because of a week in a bad district. ...It's accurate.
Why Tiger? I'm very sweet. Until somebody wastes supplies.
You keep poking the radio. ...It tickles. Please stop.
Okay, okay. Here, have a snack. Now go fight, sweetie.
Three in the morning, Recruit? ...Alright. I'm up too.
Four oh four. ...Recruit not found.
One three three seven?! That's actually elite!
Nice try. There's only one of me, Recruit.
Happy Tết! There's lucky money in the Shop. Okay, it's coins. But they're red!
New year. New you. Same training.
Oktoberfest! I'm celebrating! I cleaned every Greta twice!
Fireworks tonight. Ours are louder, though.
Chuseok. ...Family's far away. The team will do.
Golden Week! Everyone's on holiday! Except us! And them!
Hello? Recruit? ...I'm counting this as a win!
One kill?! I've seen gun cleaning take longer!
The crates don't like you today. Tomorrow they will. ...Probably.
That cat is not mine. ...Her name is Bao.
Your first Alpha. It won't be your last.
A thousand in one run?! Okay. Rival. Official.
Ten minutes. Now twenty.
Every station in one run. ...That made my day.
Your first evolution. Remember this feeling.
Ten guns! TEN! I'm not crying! Gun oil!
Fifty thousand coins. You're buying lunch, sweetie.
You made it to Whiteout! Dress warm!
Threat ten, and you're still standing. I'm writing that down.
Three minutes. No hits. That is technique.
Hat, face, top, back, pants, shoes. Try anything on, it's free.
Ooh, it's new! Tap it to put it on.
Achtung! A wall of them, from the north. Hold your ground!
Achtung! A wall of them, from the east. Hold your ground!
Achtung! A wall of them, from the south. Hold your ground!
Achtung! A wall of them, from the west. Hold your ground!
All four done! Here's your chest, sweetie. Same time tomorrow?
Three days in a row! Double shards today, just for you.
Mastery up. You and that gun are starting to understand each other.
Family bonus. Every gun of this kind hits harder now. Earned, not given.
She evolved! Look at her! My little girl, all grown up. Wunderbar!
Every last shard... and now she's whole! Welcome to the family!
